entries.0675a3825d8efdae: A renewable energy holding company that handles contracting and development and sales of solar power plants, grid-scale battery storage stations, energy conservation, power sales and maintenance.
entries.14a33d6807925a02: This business provides comprehensive energy-saving services to facilities that consume large amounts of energy, such as commercial facilities, factories and hospitals.
entries.254aed7b46e1a3fa: This business develops and sells grid-connected battery storage facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥5,711 million. It was added as a new reportable segment in the current period, and it has completed the development and sale of 10 grid-connected battery storage sites. It is carried out by West Energy Solutions Co., Ltd., West Bigin Co., Ltd. and 2 other companies.
entries.27f141f2f9b74063: This business provides comprehensive energy-saving services using LED lighting and air-conditioning equipment (West ESCO Business) and other services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,156 million. It is carried out by West Energy Solutions Co., Ltd., West Bigin Co., Ltd. and 1 other company.
entries.36bee0063dac4dc0: This category is not included in the reportable segments, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1 million.
entries.3eb8ccd636f42ce8: This business generates electricity using solar power generation systems and other equipment that it owns and sells the electricity to each electric power company.
entries.5b71655c9581b778: This business provides comprehensive management and maintenance of solar power generation systems and related equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,551 million. It is carried out by West O&M Co., Ltd.
entries.79e527c33c79ddf0: This business undertakes EPC contracts for industrial solar power plants for self-consumption and develops and sells non-FIT solar power plants. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥32,668 million, the largest of the group's businesses. Disclosed major customers are SMFL Mirai Partners Co., Ltd., with revenue of ¥8,347 million, and Daiichi Trust Taiyoko Hatsuden LLC, with revenue of ¥7,818 million. It is carried out by West Energy Solutions Co., Ltd., West Bigin Co., Ltd. and 5 other companies.
entries.9383051c393a9e50: This business carries out ongoing maintenance of solar power generation systems and related equipment so that stable power sales can continue.
entries.ab14c8a5042c90c6: This business develops and sells grid-connected battery storage facilities.
entries.bd70fbb5a8a9f234: This business develops and sells non-FIT solar power plants.

entries.fa9b63a15d407c66: This business wholesales green power and sells electricity generated by the company's own solar power generation systems and other facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥6,161 million. It is carried out by West Energy Solutions Co., Ltd., West Green Power Co., Ltd. and 32 other companies.
